correctness.rationale: Frobenius makes linear changes valid in the truncated algebra, and Jordan ranks are unchanged by extending the field. In odd characteristic the three nonzero quadratic ranks reduce to z², xy, xy+z². The first two split into monomial chains by parity or by exponent difference. For the third, the tensor calculation can be recovered in R=k[t]/(t^p) with primitive action t=X+Y. A J_p factor gives a free tensor product, by changing variables from X,Y to t,Y, using Y^p=0. For 2≤bp+1, tensor the exact sequence 0→J_(p−b)→J_p→J_b→0 with J_a. The middle term is free; elementary divisors of an inclusion into a free R-module replace each nonfree kernel block of length l with a quotient block of length p−l. broader_coverage.reasoning: The general rule covers each component tensor block—there is no claim of a new modular tensor theorem. The lift is a natural Morse consequence, not a new Morse lemma. Neither theory alone identifies the decomposition for ternary Q, its rank classes, or which partition is shared by the entire nonsingular lift stratum.

evidence: The rank-three formula is a direct application of the classical block rule once the quadratic is reduced to xy+z² and the two monomial decompositions are made. The rank-two row is exactly obtained by copying the binary partition p times.

The combined result must recognize rank from the Jordan type, sum the nonprojective block contributions with the two different parity lengths, compare all ranks, and then transport the rank-three calculation to every nonsingular lift.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The tensor machinery makes the closed formula calculable; the formula is not independent of it. The distinct outcome is the uniform classification at the level of all ternary quadratic elements and the resulting identification of the same exact regular-module partition on the whole nonsingular quadratic-leading stratum. The lower-dimensional tables do not imply that outcome.

originality.rationale: The distinct contribution is the complete rank-stratified three-variable regular-multiplication classification, with an explicit all-odd-prime rank-three partition and its extension to the full nonsingular quadratic-leading stratum. Do not credit the modular tensor rule, symmetric-matrix rank counts, binary partitions, or the formal Morse method as new. The lower-rank cases and much of the computational machinery are already covered. The inspected evidence does not establish prior equivalent coverage of the ternary classification.
residual_risks: Norman full text could not be accessed in the lawful attempts, so exact examples or additional corollaries were not ruled out.
The classification is an explicit synthesis using classical tools, not evidence that none of its derived spectra or the lift mechanism were ever stated before.

value.rationale: The quadratic layer is a natural six-dimensional coefficient space in the regular representation. The result identifies exactly what its regular multiplication remembers (quadratic rank), makes the full-rank versus rank-two projective-block jump quantitative, and gives the entire Jordan type and size of the nonsingular quadratic-leading stratum. This is a reusable structural classification, not a tabulation at isolated primes or merely an application of the block rule to one pair of lengths. It does not address degenerate lifts, characteristic two or general modules.
